senses.en: (of facts or accounts) to be the same or consistent
senses.pattern: the figures agree / agree with the facts / the two accounts agree
senses.example: The detective grew suspicious because the two witnesses' stories did not [[agree]] on several key details.
senses.example_zh: 由於兩名目擊者的說法在幾個關鍵細節上並不一致，偵探起了疑心。

senses.en: agree with sb: to suit someone's health or stomach
senses.pattern: not agree with sb / the climate agrees with her / seafood doesn't agree with me
senses.example: Spicy food does not [[agree]] with my grandfather, so we always order mild dishes for him.
senses.example_zh: 辣的食物不適合我爺爺的腸胃，所以我們總是替他點清淡的菜。
senses.note: 多用於否定句：not agree with＋人

senses.en: not good enough for someone's position or dignity
senses.pattern: beneath sb / beneath one's dignity / consider sth beneath you
senses.example: The famous chef never felt that washing dishes with his staff was [[beneath]] him.
senses.example_zh: 那位名廚從不覺得和員工一起洗碗有失他的身分。

senses.en: an organized group of people with an official role
senses.pattern: a governing body / the student body / an independent body
senses.example: The student council is the elected [[body]] that speaks for all students at our school.
senses.example_zh: 學生會是代表本校全體學生發言的民選團體。

senses.en: a large amount or mass of something
senses.pattern: a body of evidence / a large body of research / a body of water
senses.example: A large [[body]] of research shows that regular exercise improves both memory and mood.
senses.example_zh: 大量研究顯示，規律運動能同時改善記憶力與情緒。

senses.en: having a natural ability to do something well
senses.pattern: a born leader / a born teacher / a born storyteller
senses.example: Calm under pressure and trusted by everyone, Mia is a [[born]] leader on the debate team.
senses.example_zh: 米亞在壓力下沉著冷靜，又受大家信任，是辯論隊裡天生的領袖。

senses.en: (born of) existing as a result of something
senses.pattern: born of necessity / born of experience / born out of frustration
senses.example: Her decision to study medicine was [[born]] of the months she spent caring for her sick grandfather.
senses.example_zh: 她決定讀醫，是源自那幾個月照顧生病祖父的經歷。

gsat.sentence: To argue against the assumption that Russians are [[born]] drinkers.

senses.en: the shape and size of a person's body
senses.pattern: a slim build / of medium build / a muscular build
senses.example: With his powerful [[build]] and quick feet, Jason was chosen as the team's goalkeeper in his first year.
senses.example_zh: 傑森體格壯碩、腳步又快，第一年就被選為球隊的守門員。
senses.note: 此義為名詞，通常用單數

senses.en: to grow gradually in strength or amount
senses.pattern: tension builds / pressure builds / build up over time
senses.example: Excitement [[built]] steadily among the fans as the final minutes of the game ticked away.
senses.example_zh: 隨著比賽最後幾分鐘一分一秒過去，球迷的興奮之情逐漸增強。

gsat.sentence: Pus will [[build]] up in the center of the stye, causing a yellowish spot.

senses.en: (of a shop) to have a product for sale
senses.pattern: carry a wide range of / carry a brand / carry organic products
senses.example: I'm afraid we don't [[carry]] that size, but the store across the street might have it.
senses.example_zh: 我們恐怕沒有販售那個尺寸，不過對街那家店可能有。

senses.en: to involve a particular risk, penalty, or result
senses.pattern: carry a risk / carry a heavy fine / carry a warning / carry weight
senses.example: Every operation [[carries]] some risk, so the surgeon explained the procedure to the family in detail.
senses.example_zh: 每項手術都帶有一些風險，所以外科醫師向家屬詳細說明了手術過程。

senses.en: (of media) to include a news story or program
senses.pattern: carry a story / carry a report / carry the game live
senses.example: All the major newspapers [[carried]] the story of the rescue on their front pages the next morning.
senses.example_zh: 隔天早上，各大報都在頭版刊登了這則救援行動的報導。

gsat.sentence: From fashion items to rice snacks, it [[carries]] products only from local makers and small businesses owned by indigenous people.
Nor is it one of the cable networks such as CNN, which [[carries]] only news and news stories.

senses.en: to get off one vehicle and board another
senses.pattern: change trains / change planes / change buses
senses.example: There is no direct service to the coast, so you will have to [[change]] trains at the next station.
senses.example_zh: 沒有直達海岸的班車，所以你得在下一站轉乘另一班火車。

senses.en: to exchange money for another currency or smaller units
senses.pattern: change money / change dollars into yen / change a bill
senses.example: Before flying to Tokyo, Kevin went to the bank to [[change]] some dollars into Japanese yen.
senses.example_zh: 飛往東京前，凱文到銀行把一些美元兌換成日圓。

senses.en: to stop something from increasing or getting worse
senses.pattern: check the spread of / check the growth of / check inflation / keep sth in check
senses.example: Health officials closed several schools to [[check]] the spread of the flu during the winter.
senses.example_zh: 衛生官員關閉了數所學校，以抑制流感在冬季蔓延。

senses.en: a bill for a meal in a restaurant
senses.pattern: ask for the check / pay the check / split the check
senses.example: When the meal was over, Uncle Ben asked the waiter for the [[check]] and paid for everyone.
senses.example_zh: 用餐結束後，班叔叔向服務生要了帳單，替大家付了錢。

senses.en: a pattern of squares in two or more colors
senses.pattern: a check shirt / a blue and white check / a checked tablecloth
senses.example: The school uniform is a white shirt and a skirt in a green and blue [[check]].
senses.example_zh: 這所學校的制服是白襯衫配上藍綠格紋的裙子。

gsat.sentence: Red is a popular color, and women generally opt for [[checked]], striped, or patterned pieces of cloth.

senses.en: to cover something with a thin layer
senses.pattern: coat A with B / be coated with / be coated in
senses.example: Workers [[coated]] the wooden bridge with a special oil to protect it from the rain.
senses.example_zh: 工人在木橋上塗上一層特殊的油，以防雨水侵蝕。

senses.en: a layer of paint or another substance on a surface
senses.pattern: a coat of paint / a fresh coat / a second coat
senses.example: The old classroom looked much brighter after the students gave the walls a fresh [[coat]] of paint.
senses.example_zh: 學生替牆壁刷上一層新油漆後，舊教室看起來明亮多了。
senses.note: 名詞 coating 也指塗層、覆蓋層

senses.en: the fur or hair covering an animal's body
senses.pattern: a thick coat / a shiny coat / shed its coat
senses.example: The mountain goat grows a thick white [[coat]] that keeps it warm through the freezing winter.
senses.example_zh: 這種山羊會長出厚厚的白色皮毛，讓牠在嚴冬中保暖。

gsat.sentence: Researchers found that commercial popcorn companies often [[coat]] their microwave popcorn bags with a chemical called perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) which has been found to cause both cancer and lung disease in laboratory animals.
He then [[coated]] the glue on a paper sample and found that it was not only a good bookmark, but it was great for writing notes.

senses.en: feeling relaxed and confident about something
senses.pattern: be comfortable with / feel comfortable doing / be comfortable speaking in public
senses.example: Not every student feels [[comfortable]] asking questions in front of the whole class.
senses.example_zh: 並非每個學生都能自在地在全班面前發問。

senses.en: having enough money to live well
senses.pattern: a comfortable income / a comfortable living / a comfortable retirement
senses.example: The retired couple are not rich, but they are [[comfortable]] enough to travel abroad every year.
senses.example_zh: 這對退休夫婦並不富有，但生活夠寬裕，每年都能出國旅行。

gsat.sentence: Most of us are [[comfortable]] with eye contact lasting a few seconds.
However, since it kept orbiting around the Earth without any consequences, scientists became increasingly [[comfortable]] abandoning things that no longer served any useful purpose in space.

senses.en: to be important or have value
senses.pattern: every vote counts / what counts is / it is the thought that counts / count for little
senses.example: In a job interview, first impressions [[count]], so dress neatly and arrive on time.
senses.example_zh: 求職面試時第一印象很重要，所以要穿著整齊並準時到場。

senses.en: to consider someone or something to be something
senses.pattern: count oneself lucky / count him as a friend / be counted among the best
senses.example: I [[count]] myself lucky to have had such patient teachers throughout high school.
senses.example_zh: 高中三年都遇到這麼有耐心的老師，我認為自己很幸運。

senses.en: an aim or purpose
senses.pattern: a means to an end / to this end / an end in itself / achieve one's own ends
senses.example: For her, money is only a means to an [[end]]; what she really wants is freedom to travel.
senses.example_zh: 對她來說，金錢只是達成目的的手段；她真正想要的是旅行的自由。

senses.en: to require someone to do something as a duty
senses.pattern: be expected to do / expect sb to do / expect sth from sb
senses.example: At this school, all students are [[expected]] to clean their own classrooms before going home.
senses.example_zh: 在這所學校，所有學生都被要求在放學回家前打掃自己的教室。

senses.en: to be going to have a baby
senses.pattern: be expecting / be expecting a baby / be expecting twins
senses.example: My aunt is [[expecting]] her second baby in June, so we are already shopping for tiny clothes.
senses.example_zh: 我阿姨懷孕了，第二胎預計六月出生，所以我們已經開始買嬰兒服。
senses.note: 此義只用進行式 be expecting

gsat.sentence: “You [[expect]] us to play seven days a week for merely five rupees!” they yelled.

senses.en: to happen on a particular day or date
senses.pattern: fall on a Sunday / fall on the same day / fall in early February
senses.example: My birthday [[falls]] on a Saturday this year, so we can have a party at the beach.
senses.example_zh: 我今年的生日適逢星期六，所以我們可以在海邊辦派對。

senses.en: to belong to a particular group or category
senses.pattern: fall into a category / fall into three groups / fall under the heading of
senses.example: Most of the complaints we received [[fall]] into two groups: slow delivery and damaged packaging.
senses.example_zh: 我們收到的投訴大多可歸入兩類：送貨太慢和包裝受損。

gsat.sentence: Flower and plant names like Heather, Rosemary, and Iris [[fall]] into this category.
Your dog could [[fall]] into one of nine categories: Ace, Stargazer, Maverick, Charmer, Socialite, Protodog, Einstein, Expert, or Renaissance Dog.

senses.en: (of water) not salty
senses.pattern: fresh water / a supply of fresh water / fresh and salt water
senses.example: Salmon are born in [[fresh]] water, swim out to sea, and later return to the same river.
senses.example_zh: 鮭魚在淡水中出生，游向大海，之後再回到同一條河流。
senses.note: 形容詞 freshwater：淡水的（置於名詞前）

senses.en: new and different from what existed before
senses.pattern: a fresh start / fresh evidence / a fresh look at / fresh ideas
senses.example: After moving to another city, Brian saw the new school as a chance to make a [[fresh]] start.
senses.example_zh: 搬到另一個城市後，布萊恩把新學校看作一次全新開始的機會。

gsat.sentence: The urgent need to turn seawater into [[fresh]] water.
Its worldwide popularity is mainly due to its theme music, which showcases ABBA’s timeless songs in a [[fresh]] and vital way that retains the essence of both pop music and good musical theater.

senses.en: the central or most important part
senses.pattern: the heart of the city / the heart of the matter / at the heart of
senses.example: Trust lies at the [[heart]] of every good friendship, and it takes years to build.
senses.example_zh: 信任是每段良好友誼的核心，而且需要多年才能建立。

senses.en: courage, hope, or enthusiasm
senses.pattern: lose heart / take heart / put one's heart into
senses.example: Do not lose [[heart]] after one bad exam; you still have plenty of time to improve.
senses.example_zh: 別因為一次考試考差就失去信心，你還有很多時間可以進步。

gsat.sentence: Located at the [[heart]] of Paris, this medieval cathedral is noted for its intricate architecture, stunning stained glass windows, and, above all, its bells.
They came from northwest England, the blackened [[heart]] of the Industrial Revolution: Its main street was “a dark, unattractive hole” and the river running through it was a string of dirty water.

senses.en: great in amount, degree, or seriousness
senses.pattern: heavy losses / a heavy fine / pay a heavy price
senses.example: The typhoon caused [[heavy]] losses to banana farmers in the southern part of the island.
senses.example_zh: 颱風使島嶼南部的蕉農蒙受嚴重的損失。

senses.en: doing a particular thing a lot or too much
senses.pattern: a heavy smoker / a heavy drinker / a heavy sleeper / a heavy user
senses.example: As a [[heavy]] user of social media, Amy checks her phone more than a hundred times a day.
senses.example_zh: 身為社群媒體的重度使用者，艾咪一天查看手機超過一百次。
senses.note: a heavy meal＝油膩難消化的一餐

gsat.sentence: The [[heaviest]] drinkers in medieval Europe were actually Germans.

senses.en: no longer alive; recently dead
senses.pattern: the late poet / her late husband / the late Mr. Brown
senses.example: The museum displays letters written by the [[late]] poet, who died in 1985.
senses.example_zh: 博物館展出這位已故詩人所寫的書信，他於一九八五年過世。

senses.en: near the end of a period of time
senses.pattern: in the late 19th century / in her late twenties / late summer
senses.example: The stone bridge was built in the [[late]] eighteenth century and is still in use today.
senses.example_zh: 這座石橋建於十八世紀晚期，至今仍在使用。

gsat.sentence: The melted bells were recast in the [[late]] 19th century.
The liquid was originally a grape alcohol introduced from France in the [[late]] 14th century.

senses.en: a period of time away from work
senses.pattern: sick leave / maternity leave / on leave / take a week's leave
senses.example: Our math teacher is on maternity [[leave]], so a substitute will teach us until June.
senses.example_zh: 我們的數學老師正在休產假，所以代課老師會教我們到六月。

senses.en: to give something to someone after you die
senses.pattern: leave sth to sb / leave sb a fortune / leave money to charity
senses.example: The childless farmer [[left]] all his land to the village school in his will.
senses.example_zh: 那位沒有子女的農夫在遺囑中把所有土地遺贈給村裡的學校。

senses.en: to cause someone or something to be in a state
senses.pattern: leave sb homeless / leave sth unchecked / be left vacant / leave sb speechless
senses.example: The earthquake [[left]] thousands of families homeless and cut off electricity for a week.
senses.example_zh: 地震使數千個家庭無家可歸，並造成停電一星期。

gsat.sentence: The study warned that Papua’s glaciers are only the “first to go” if greenhouse gases are [[left]] unchecked and temperatures continue rising.
[[Left]] vacant for years, the deserted house was filled with a thick coating of dust and a smell of old damp wood.

senses.en: to completely flatten or destroy buildings or an area
senses.pattern: level a building / level the town / level the ground
senses.example: The powerful typhoon [[leveled]] hundreds of wooden houses along the coast in a single night.
senses.example_zh: 強烈颱風一夜之間把沿岸數百棟木屋夷為平地。
senses.note: 英式拼法過去式為 levelled

senses.en: flat; at the same height as something else
senses.pattern: level ground / a level surface / level with the window / a level teaspoon
senses.example: Make sure the ground is [[level]] before you set up the tent for the night.
senses.example_zh: 晚上搭帳篷之前，要先確定地面是平坦的。

senses.en: to form rows along the sides of something
senses.pattern: line the streets / be lined with trees / line the route
senses.example: Thousands of fans [[lined]] the streets to welcome the baseball team home.
senses.example_zh: 數千名球迷沿街排列，歡迎棒球隊凱旋歸來。

senses.en: a type of work or business
senses.pattern: line of work / line of business / What line of work are you in?
senses.example: In her [[line]] of work, staying calm under pressure matters more than speed.
senses.example_zh: 在她這個行業，在壓力下保持冷靜比速度更重要。

senses.en: the words an actor speaks in a play or film
senses.pattern: learn one's lines / forget one's lines / deliver a line
senses.example: The young actor forgot his [[lines]] halfway through the play and had to improvise.
senses.example_zh: 那位年輕演員戲演到一半忘了台詞，只好即興發揮。

gsat.sentence: Public dwellings [[lined]] its ground level; a marketplace and two mosques also fit comfortably inside.
In this [[line]] of work, the person is paid to do daring actions that are deemed too risky for the regular actor to perform, including jumping from heights, crashing cars, or fighting with weapons.

senses.en: a means of communicating or expressing something
senses.pattern: a medium of communication / a medium of instruction / through the medium of television
senses.example: For many teenagers, short videos have become the main [[medium]] for sharing ideas.
senses.example_zh: 對許多青少年來說，短影音已成為分享想法的主要媒介。
senses.note: 複數為 media 或 mediums

senses.en: the material or form an artist uses
senses.pattern: an artist's medium / work in different media / mixed media
senses.example: The artist's favorite [[medium]] is watercolor, though she sometimes works in clay.
senses.example_zh: 這位藝術家最喜歡的創作材料是水彩，不過她有時也用黏土創作。

senses.en: to be careful about something
senses.pattern: mind your step / mind your head / mind your manners
senses.example: [[Mind]] the wet floor near the entrance; someone slipped there just a few minutes ago.
senses.example_zh: 當心入口附近濕滑的地板，幾分鐘前才有人在那裡滑倒。
senses.note: 多用於祈使句，如 Mind your step.

senses.en: a very intelligent person
senses.pattern: the brightest minds / great minds / one of the finest minds
senses.example: The conference brought together some of the brightest [[minds]] in medicine to fight the new disease.
senses.example_zh: 這場會議匯集了醫學界一些最聰明的人才，共同對抗這種新疾病。

senses.en: the basic character or qualities of something
senses.pattern: the nature of the problem / by nature / similar in nature
senses.example: Because of the dangerous [[nature]] of the job, firefighters must train for months before their first mission.
senses.example_zh: 由於這份工作具有危險的性質，消防員首次出任務前必須受訓數月。

senses.en: the character a person or animal is born with
senses.pattern: human nature / a gentle nature / it is not in sb's nature to
senses.example: It is not in her [[nature]] to give up, even when everyone else thinks the task is impossible.
senses.example_zh: 輕言放棄不是她的天性，即使其他人都認為這項任務不可能完成。

gsat.sentence: Racist remarks are by [[nature]] offensive and hurtful, and should be avoided on all occasions.

French psychologist Alfred Binet (1859-1911) took a different approach from most other psychologists of his day: He was interested in the workings of the normal mind rather than the [[nature]] of mental illness.

senses.en: to mention something or notice it carefully
senses.pattern: note that / as noted above / it should be noted that / note the difference
senses.example: In her report, the researcher [[noted]] that the birds arrived two weeks earlier than usual.
senses.example_zh: 研究人員在報告中指出，這些鳥比往年早了兩個星期抵達。

senses.en: a single musical sound, or the symbol for it
senses.pattern: a high note / a low note / hit a high note / play a wrong note
senses.example: The singer could not reach the highest [[note]] in the song, so she sang it an octave lower.
senses.example_zh: 那位歌手唱不上歌曲裡最高的那個音，於是降了八度來唱。

gsat.sentence: Some documents [[noted]] that Russians “indulge in excessive drinking whenever the occasion arises,” while others claimed that Russians “rarely drink wine.”
Some studies even show that people may all be synesthetic to some degree. As is often observed, most of us tend to associate lower [[notes]] with darker colors and higher notes with brighter colors.

senses.en: (of a planned event) cancelled
senses.pattern: the game is off / the deal is off / the wedding is off
senses.example: Because of the approaching typhoon, tomorrow's school sports day is [[off]].
senses.example_zh: 由於颱風逼近，明天的學校運動會取消了。

senses.en: not as good as usual; not quite right
senses.pattern: sth feels off / have an off day / sound a little off
senses.example: The singer's voice sounded a little [[off]] tonight, probably because she had a cold.
senses.example_zh: 這位歌手今晚的聲音聽起來有點不對勁，大概是因為她感冒了。
senses.note: 英式英語也指食物「變質的」

senses.en: to have something because of someone's help
senses.pattern: owe one's success to / owe one's life to / owe it all to
senses.example: The singer says she [[owes]] her career to a teacher who encouraged her to keep practicing.
senses.example_zh: 這位歌手說，她把自己的歌唱事業歸功於一位鼓勵她持續練習的老師。

senses.en: to have a duty to give someone something
senses.pattern: owe somebody an apology / owe somebody an explanation / owe somebody a favor
senses.example: You [[owe]] your sister an apology for reading her diary without permission.
senses.example_zh: 你未經允許就看妹妹的日記，應該給她一個道歉。

gsat.sentence: The young man [[owes]] his success to many people, his parents in particular.

senses.en: low in quality; not good
senses.pattern: poor quality / poor eyesight / in poor health / a poor memory
senses.example: Because of [[poor]] lighting in the hall, many students found it hard to read the exam paper.
senses.example_zh: 由於禮堂的照明不佳，許多學生覺得很難看清考卷。

senses.en: having very little of a particular thing
senses.pattern: be poor in nutrients / poor in natural resources / poor in vitamins
senses.example: The soil here is [[poor]] in nutrients, so farmers must add fertilizer every season.
senses.example_zh: 這裡的土壤缺乏養分，所以農民每一季都得施肥。

gsat.sentence: The absence of smiles stemmed partly from the attempt to hide their decayed teeth caused by [[poor]] dental hygiene.
Some hotels may not provide air conditioning in the capsules, leading to [[poor]] air flow.

senses.en: to express doubt about whether something is true or right
senses.pattern: question a decision / question the wisdom of / question whether / question someone's honesty
senses.example: Several scientists have [[questioned]] the study's results because it tested only twenty people.
senses.example_zh: 有幾位科學家質疑這項研究的結果，因為它只測試了二十個人。

senses.en: to ask someone questions officially, especially about a crime
senses.pattern: question a suspect / question witnesses / be questioned by police / question someone about
senses.example: Police [[questioned]] three witnesses about what they had seen outside the bank that night.
senses.example_zh: 警方訊問了三名目擊者，了解他們當晚在銀行外看到了什麼。

senses.en: doubt or uncertainty about something
senses.pattern: call something into question / beyond question / open to question / no question that
senses.example: Her talent is beyond [[question]], but she still needs more experience on the stage.
senses.example_zh: 她的才華毫無疑問，但她仍需要更多舞台經驗。

gsat.sentence: After several years of physical suffering and near financial ruin from the medical costs, the couple began [[questioning]] the treatment after consulting with other patients in online support groups.
The scientist’s project to build a modern laboratory was called into [[question]] on account of its huge budget.

senses.en: a group of people with shared ancestry and physical features
senses.pattern: people of all races / regardless of race / race and gender
senses.example: The law protects every citizen from unfair treatment, regardless of [[race]], religion, or gender.
senses.example_zh: 這項法律保護每位公民不受不公平對待，不分種族、宗教或性別。

senses.en: to move or beat extremely fast
senses.pattern: sb's heart races / race to the hospital / race down the stairs
senses.example: My heart was [[racing]] as I stepped onto the stage to give my first speech.
senses.example_zh: 我走上講臺發表第一次演講時，心臟狂跳不已。

gsat.sentence: Their unique style, as remarked by Karen Blixen, author of Out of Africa, “has grown from the inside, and is an expression of the [[race]] and its history.”

senses.en: (of food) containing a lot of butter, cream, or fat
senses.pattern: rich food / a rich chocolate cake / a rich sauce / too rich for me
senses.example: The cream sauce was so [[rich]] that I could only finish half of the pasta.
senses.example_zh: 奶油醬太過濃郁油膩，我只吃得下半盤義大利麵。

senses.en: (of soil) containing what plants need to grow well
senses.pattern: rich soil / rich farmland / rich earth
senses.example: Farmers settled along the river because its [[rich]] soil produced two crops every year.
senses.example_zh: 農民沿河定居，因為那裡肥沃的土壤一年可以收成兩次。

senses.en: to formally support a proposal at a meeting
senses.pattern: second a motion / second a proposal / I'll second that
senses.example: When no one offered to [[second]] the motion, the chairperson moved on to the next item.
senses.example_zh: 沒有人附議這項動議，主席便接著討論下一個議題。

senses.en: a dish offered only that day, or a product on sale
senses.pattern: today's special / the lunch special / a weekly special
senses.example: Today's [[special]] is grilled fish with rice and soup, and it costs only ninety dollars.
senses.example_zh: 今日特餐是烤魚配飯和湯，只要九十元。

senses.en: a TV or radio program made for a particular occasion
senses.pattern: a TV special / a New Year special / a two-hour special
senses.example: The channel will air a two-hour [[special]] on sea turtles this Saturday night.
senses.example_zh: 該頻道本週六晚上將播出兩小時的海龜特別節目。

senses.en: not moving; calm and quiet
senses.pattern: stand still / sit still / keep still / still water
senses.example: The photographer asked the children to stand [[still]] for a few seconds while he took the picture.
senses.example_zh: 攝影師請孩子們站著靜止不動幾秒鐘，好讓他拍照。

senses.en: despite what has just been said
senses.pattern: Still, + clause / but still / and still
senses.example: The hike was long and tiring. [[Still]], everyone agreed that the view from the top was worth it.
senses.example_zh: 這趟健行又長又累。儘管如此，大家都認為山頂的景色很值得。
senses.note: 常置於句首，後面加逗號

gsat.sentence: [[Still]], many animal rights activists believe the cost of confining animals outweighs the benefits.
To make sure that your pet sits [[still]].

senses.en: a strong trend, or a growing amount of something unpleasant
senses.pattern: the tide of public opinion / turn the tide / a rising tide of / go against the tide
senses.example: The [[tide]] of public opinion has turned against single-use plastic in recent years.
senses.example_zh: 近年來，輿論的潮流已轉向反對一次性塑膠。

senses.en: to help someone get through a difficult period
senses.pattern: tide sb over / tide sb over until payday / enough to tide us over
senses.example: His sister lent him some money to [[tide]] him over until he found a new job.
senses.example_zh: 他姊姊借他一些錢，幫他度過找到新工作前的難關。
senses.note: 須與 over 連用：tide sb over

gsat.sentence: Both issues result from the [[tide]] of violence that has crossed the region in recent years.

senses.en: the amount of data or visits on a network
senses.pattern: web traffic / internet traffic / drive traffic to a site
senses.example: After the video went viral, [[traffic]] to the museum's website doubled in a single week.
senses.example_zh: 影片爆紅後，博物館網站的流量在一週內就增加了一倍。

senses.en: to buy and sell something illegally
senses.pattern: traffic in drugs / traffic in wildlife / human trafficking
senses.example: The gang was arrested for [[trafficking]] in rare birds caught illegally in the rainforest.
senses.example_zh: 該幫派因非法買賣在雨林中違法捕捉的珍稀鳥類而遭逮捕。

senses.en: the same in all parts or at all times
senses.pattern: uniform in size / a uniform standard / uniform in color / a uniform temperature
senses.example: The bricks must be [[uniform]] in size, or the wall will not stand straight.
senses.example_zh: 磚塊的大小必須一致，否則牆面會砌不直。

senses.en: to go with someone on foot to a place
senses.pattern: walk sb home / walk sb to the station / walk sb to the door
senses.example: It was getting dark, so Kevin offered to [[walk]] his classmate to the bus stop.
senses.example_zh: 天色漸暗，所以凱文主動提議陪同學走到公車站。

senses.en: a person's job or position in society
senses.pattern: all walks of life / every walk of life / different walks of life
senses.example: The marathon attracted runners from all [[walks]] of life, including doctors, farmers, and students.
senses.example_zh: 這場馬拉松吸引了來自各行業、各階層的跑者，包括醫生、農夫和學生。
senses.note: 固定用法 from all walks of life

gsat.sentence: Jack’s clients are from all [[walks]] of life.

senses.en: (of eyes or mouth) to fill with liquid
senses.pattern: make your eyes water / make your mouth water / eyes watering from smoke
senses.example: The smell of fried chicken from the kitchen made my mouth [[water]] before dinner was ready.
senses.example_zh: 廚房飄來的炸雞香味，讓我在晚餐還沒好之前就流口水了。

senses.en: an area of sea or lake, often a country's
senses.pattern: coastal waters / in international waters / the waters off the coast / shallow waters
senses.example: Fishing boats are not allowed to enter these protected [[waters]] during the breeding season.
senses.example_zh: 繁殖季期間，漁船不得進入這片受保護的水域。

gsat.sentence: Situated off the coast of Tanzania and washed by the warm, clean [[waters]] of the Indian Ocean, Zanzibar is a tropical archipelago comprised of several scattered islands.
From Turkey, she boarded a small boat that held 20 people and set sail into the deep [[waters]] of the Aegean Sea.

senses.en: considering the fact that; since
senses.pattern: how can … when … / why … when … / what's the point when …
senses.example: How can you expect to pass the test [[when]] you never open your textbook?
senses.example_zh: 既然你從來不翻開課本，怎麼能指望通過考試呢？

senses.en: although; despite the fact that
senses.pattern: when in fact / when actually / when sb could have done
senses.example: She walked all the way home in the rain [[when]] she could easily have taken the bus.
senses.example_zh: 她明明可以輕鬆搭公車，卻一路淋雨走回家。

quiz.stem: The sports association is the governing ______ that sets the rules for all high school basketball tournaments in the country.
quiz.explain_zh: body＝團體、機構。該運動協會是制定全國高中籃球賽規則的管理機構。

quiz.stem: The concert was held in memory of the ______ conductor, who had led the city orchestra for thirty years before his death in 2010.
quiz.explain_zh: late＝已故的。這場音樂會是為了紀念那位已故的指揮而舉辦。

quiz.stem: The proud manager considered it ______ him to answer phones or serve coffee, so he always left such tasks to the newest employees.
quiz.explain_zh: beneath＝有失…的身分。高傲的經理認為接電話、倒咖啡有失身分。

quiz.stem: The baker rolls out the dough to a ______ thickness so that all the cookies on the tray bake at the same speed.
quiz.explain_zh: uniform＝一致的。麵團擀成一致的厚度，餅乾才會同時烤熟。

quiz.stem: Because of a serious knee injury, the firefighter was given three months of sick ______ to rest and recover at home.
quiz.explain_zh: leave＝休假。消防員因膝蓋受傷，獲准請三個月病假在家休養。

quiz.stem: Because the national holiday ______ on a Sunday this year, workers will be given the following Monday off instead.
quiz.explain_zh: fall＝適逢（某日）。國定假日適逢星期日，所以星期一補假。

quiz.stem: Witnesses described the thief as a young man of medium ______ with short black hair, wearing a blue cap and carrying a sports bag.
quiz.explain_zh: build＝體格、身材。目擊者形容小偷是中等身材、黑色短髮的年輕男子。

quiz.stem: The small pharmacy near my house doesn't ______ the vitamin brand my doctor recommended, so I had to order it online.
quiz.explain_zh: carry＝販售、備有。家附近的藥局沒賣醫生推薦的維他命，只好上網訂購。

quiz.stem: At the class meeting, Kevin proposed holding a charity sale, and since several classmates were quick to ______ the idea, it was put to a vote right away.
quiz.explain_zh: second＝附議、贊同。同學立刻附議 Kevin 的義賣提案，於是馬上表決。

quiz.stem: The city hopes to cut traffic accidents by half, and to that ______, it has lowered the speed limit near every school.
quiz.explain_zh: end＝目的。為了達到車禍減半的目的，市府調降學校附近的速限。
